# 铁路计划、线路与覆盖文件

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`parseRailwayPlan` 校验外部输入并给出带类型的计划；`createRailwayOverlay` 在 ProvinceAtlas 上规划路线，合并成铁路输出。路线使用实际相邻陆地省份，等级由 `RailwayLevel` 限定。`via` 等路径约束属于线路请求，输出计划记录最终经过的省份。

在项目工作流中，把计划或接收 atlas 的回调传给 ProjectOptions.railways，可确保使用最终有效世界。不要把地区 ID 当作省份线路节点。

## createRailwayOverlay() { #createrailwayoverlay }

> **createRailwayOverlay**(`files`: `ReadonlyMap`&lt;`string`, [`WorldFile`](world.md#worldfile)&gt;, `plan`: [`RailwayPlan`](#railwayplan), `source?`: `string`, `suppliedAtlas?`: [`ProvinceAtlas`](atlas.md#provinceatlas)): [`RailwayOverlayResult`](#railwayoverlayresult)

Defined in: [src/project/atlas-railways.ts:122](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/atlas-railways.ts#L122)

Plan safe new land paths, retain the complete base file byte-for-byte, and append only absent edges.
Existing special connections are preserved, not reinterpreted as ordinary land borders.
Equal-level overlaps are shared; conflicting levels are errors, never implicit upgrades.

### Parameters { #createrailwayoverlay-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type | Default value |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `files` | `ReadonlyMap`&lt;`string`, [`WorldFile`](world.md#worldfile)&gt; | `undefined` |
| `plan` | [`RailwayPlan`](#railwayplan) | `undefined` |
| `source?` | `string` | `"<railway plan>"` |
| `suppliedAtlas?` | [`ProvinceAtlas`](atlas.md#provinceatlas) | `undefined` |

### Returns { #createrailwayoverlay-section-returns }

[`RailwayOverlayResult`](#railwayoverlayresult)

### Example { #createrailwayoverlay-section-example }

```ts
const overlay = createRailwayOverlay(world.effectiveFiles, {
  routes: [{ name: "new-corridor", level: 2, via: [6521, 6282] }],
});
if (overlay.file) console.log(overlay.file.path); // map/railways.txt
```
